errors.evidence: The description misinterprets the units. The y-axis is labeled "Tokens (K)", meaning units of thousands. The numbers above the bars (e.g., 10584 for News) are the absolute token counts. The description incorrectly appends 'K' to these absolute numbers, suggesting the values are 1000 times larger than they actually are (e.g., stating 10,584K tokens instead of the correct 10,584 tokens or 10.584K tokens). This error is repeated for every category value.
